description: This line plot illustrates the Average Correct Gate Rate across different Embedding Layers for four distinct input types, with shaded regions indicating variance around each line. The x-axis, labeled "Embedding Layer," utilizes a linear scale with data ranging from 0 to 31, featuring numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Average Correct Gate Rate," employs a linear scale with a visible tick range from 0.2 to 1.0 and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains four lines, none of which use markers. The solid light blue line, representing "Character Attention input," begins at an x-value of 0 with a y-value of approximately 0.10, rises to a peak of roughly 0.81 at layer 4, declines to a minimum of 0.25 at layer 12, and subsequently rises with fluctuations to end at approximately 0.73 at layer 31. The dashed light blue line, representing "Character MLP input," starts at x=0 with a y-value of 0.83, peaks at 0.94 at layer 3, drops to a low of 0.53 at layer 12, and then rises to maintain a high plateau, ending at 0.82 at layer 31. The solid dark red line, representing "Wiki Attention input," starts at x=0 with a y-value of 0.20, increases to a peak of 0.80 at layer 5, decreases to a minimum of 0.37 at layer 13, and then rises with fluctuations to finish at 0.69 at layer 31. Finally, the dashed dark red line, representing "Wiki MLP input," begins at x=0 with a y-value of 0.82, reaches a peak of 0.89 at layer 3, declines to 0.60 at layer 12, and rises to a steady plateau, concluding at 0.85 at layer 31.
